description: Use when an agent needs the basic facts about a domain. Returns its DNS A, AAAA, MX, NS and TXT records and the live TLS certificate: issuer, alternative names, validity dates and days to expiry. Public hosts only; no registrar data. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

domain.description: a hostname such as example.com (no URL, no IP address)

name: get_domain
